periods.label: Ancient
periods.summary: Massed foot and horse, chariots, oared ships.
guidance: Name formations, not head counts: "Hoplite phalanx", "Skirmishers", "Companion cavalry".
Weapons are melee, javelin, sling and bow. Name strikes "Melee", "Cavalry charge", "Javelin volley" or "Arrow volley".
There is no road network: routes cross open ground and follow the terrain.

packs.name: Ancient formations
packs.description: Phalanx, legion, skirmishers, horse and chariots.

periods.label: Medieval
periods.summary: Men-at-arms, longbows, knights, castles and siege engines.
guidance: Name formations clearly: "Longbowmen", "Dismounted men-at-arms", "Mounted knights", "Royal standard", "Baggage train".
Name strikes "Longbow volley" for arrows and "Melee" or "Cavalry charge" for close combat.
Ground is the story: mud, woods and a narrow frontage decide these battles. Say so in the captions.

packs.name: Medieval formations
packs.description: Men-at-arms, longbows, knights, siege and the baggage train.

periods.label: Gunpowder
periods.summary: Pike and shot, musket lines, field cannon, sailing warships.
guidance: Formations are battalions and squadrons: "Line infantry", "Pike block", "Grenadiers", "Horse".
Name strikes "Musket volley", "Cannonade" or "Broadside". Ranges are short: a few hundred metres for muskets.
Powder smoke hangs over the field; a little haze suits these scenes.

packs.name: Pike and shot
packs.description: Musket lines, pike blocks, field guns and ships of the line.

periods.label: Industrial
periods.summary: Rifled muskets, massed artillery, railways, ironclads.
guidance: Formations are regiments and batteries: "Rifle regiment", "Field battery", "Cavalry squadron".
Name strikes "Rifle volley", "Artillery barrage" or "Naval gunfire".
Railways and the telegraph shape the approach march; the present-day road network does not, so keep routes off modern highways.

packs.name: Industrial-age formations
packs.description: Rifle regiments, massed batteries, cavalry screens and ironclads.

periods.label: First World War
periods.summary: Trench lines, barrages, early tanks and aircraft.
guidance: Front lines are territories, not units: draw trench systems as territories and the attack as arrows across no man’s land.
Name strikes "Creeping barrage", "Counter-battery fire" or "Machine gun fire". A barrage is a salvo, not a single blast.
Aircraft are scouts and observers; do not give them guided weapons.

packs.name: Western Front 1914–18
packs.description: Trench garrisons, barrages, the first tanks and scout aircraft.

periods.label: Second World War
periods.summary: Combined arms, armoured thrusts, amphibious landings, strategic bombing.
guidance: Use period icons: halftrack, propfighter, propbomber, higgins, uboat. No jets, drones, helicopters or satellites.
Name strikes "Bomb run", "Artillery barrage", "Naval gunfire" or "Strafing run"; bomb sticks and strafing runs use pattern "line".
Radio exists; datalink and precision guidance do not. Keep effects to radio calls.

packs.name: Second World War combined arms
packs.description: Armour, half-tracks, piston aircraft, landing craft and U-boats.

periods.label: Cold War
periods.summary: Jets, helicopters, missile air defence, mechanised corps.
guidance: Guided weapons exist but are few; most fires are guns, rockets and unguided bombs.
Air defence is a real constraint: give launcher units airDefenseKm and route aircraft around it.
No armed drones and no live satellite imagery feeds; reconnaissance is film and photo passes.

packs.name: Cold War mechanised forces
packs.description: Mechanised divisions, jets, helicopters and missile air defence.

periods.label: Modern
periods.summary: Precision fires, drones, networked sensors, satellites.
guidance: Precision weapons need explicit launchAt and targetUnitId so the flight time reads correctly.
Show sensing as well as shooting: sensorKm, airDefenseKm, datalink effects and an imaging satellite pass.
Do not invent jamming, casualty figures or sensor footage that sources do not support.

packs.name: Modern Western forces
packs.description: Precision fires, rotary wing, drones and sensors.

packs.name: Modern Eastern and irregular forces
packs.description: Mechanised regiments, technicals, layered air defence.
